title: Ning Li and Smalley took $400,000 in Army Research Lab money and delivered nothing

tellings.quote: and and they made off with $400,000 in army research lab money and didn't produce a producible for it. They didn't deliver anything for that money.

related.note: Both are about the defense money Li and Smalley's company received. This telling says Li then went silent into secret work; Davis says they took the money and delivered nothing.

plain: Two physicists at the University of Alabama in Huntsville, Ning Li and Larry Smalley, took $400,000 from the Army Research Laboratory, the US Army's main research lab, and produced nothing for it, according to Eric W. Davis, a physicist who has worked on government-funded studies of advanced propulsion. Davis tells Michels that "they didn't deliver anything for that money," a claim that casts doubt on their gravity research, and he names a colleague, Travis Taylor, in the same account.
